question: Bhavartha Dipika and Amritanubhava are the sacred books of the people of ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Maharashtra**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Bhavartha Dipika and Amritanubhava **are the sacred books of the people of Maharasthra written by **Saint Dyaneshwar of Maharashtra**. 
 
• **Bhavartha Dipika **is the commentary book on **Bhagavad Geeta written in the Marathi language**.
 
• It is considered the **oldest surviving literary work of Marathi Literature**.__
 
• **Amritanubhav **is composed by the **poet Sant Dnyaneshwar during the 13th century.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Sant Dnyaneshwar, also referred to as Jnaneshwar **was born in 1275 in Maharashtra.**
 
• He was an **Indian Marathi saint, poet, philosopher, and yogi of the Nath Shaiva and Varkari tradition.**
 
• He authored many books in his short life **span of 21 years**.
